text: The relevant ecosystem spans the patient, provider, insurer, delegated reviewers and community services. There is no fixed universal headcount. A role is a function, not necessarily a separate employee: referral, scheduling and authorization may be combined in one job; a physician may act as treating clinician and later join a peer discussion.
